title: 第一卷 第1章 大帝九世轮回成了胎儿第一卷 第2章 叶无尘出手逆天改命
lines: “九世轮回，这就是我的第九世吗？”
叶无尘恢复了意识，却发现自己根本睁不开双眼，身体悬空漂浮，暖洋洋的，被一股液体所包裹。
下凡投胎？
还在母亲肚子里？
一代大帝，成了未出生的胎儿……
叶无尘思绪有些混乱，而后开始探知外面的世界。
只见侯门府院内，一名年轻女子正跪在大雪之中，嘴唇青紫，瑟瑟发抖，神情异常却倔强。
她衣着单薄，身形娇弱，腹部微隆，俨然已经怀了身孕。
“她就是我这一世的母亲？”
叶无尘不禁有些愤怒，而今已是十二月，漫天飘雪，冰冻三尺，一个孕妇居然被罚跪在雪地中。
在正前方有一座大殿，府中人员进进出出，无不用怪异或鄙夷的目光看向年轻女子，指指点点，小声议论起来。
“叶琉璃，嫁入我姜家八年都不曾怀上孩子，而今丈夫还在外征战呢，忽然就有了，也不知道怀了谁的野种！”
“嘘，这话可不能乱说，少夫人平日里待我们挺和善的，她不像是那种人。”
“知人知面不知心，平日里装圣洁，谁知道叶琉璃骨子里有多水性杨花！”
“哎，少夫人自圣山求药后身体便羸弱不堪，现在已经在雪中跪了十个时辰，肚中还有胎儿，真怕她会撑不住，一尸两命。”
叶琉璃并不理会那些外人的议论声，不屈的目光始终盯着大殿之内。
这时，大殿中传出一位老姬的声音：
“叶琉璃，老身最后告诫你一次，七日之内必须流掉肚中胎儿！”
“你出身卑贱，体弱多病，生养出来的孩子，就是没有灵根的废物，只会辱没我镇北侯府的门楣，听懂了吗？”
此人高高在上，语气之刻薄，态度之歹毒，简直令人窒息。
叶琉璃眼眶发红，不服哽咽道：“我叶家世世代代跟随侯爷南征北战，为侯爷出生入死，忠义无双，期间不知牺牲了多少英勇儿郎，叶家所做的一切，在您口中仅仅换来卑贱二字的评价吗？”
“我体弱多病，那是因为三年前文康身负重伤，我不得不去圣山求药，才遭受了诅咒反噬所致！”
“文康也是您的亲儿子啊，我怀中的骨肉也是您的亲孙子啊，难道您就没有一丝一毫的情感吗？”
大殿内，沉默了片刻。
随后老姬用更强硬的声音回应道：“正因为侯爷有功必赏，才让你一介叶家之女能嫁入侯府，享受这无尽的荣光，你不懂得珍惜就算了，还生出痴念，何其愚蠢！”
“更因为念及你三年前为文康求药之情，老身才对你格外宽容，否则早就治你个以下犯上的大罪，家法伺候了！”
叶琉璃眼中带泪，自嘲一笑道：“我叶家满门忠烈，为镇北侯府立下累累战功，我为了治愈夫君的伤势，不惜去圣山求药而染上凶煞诅咒，这一桩桩一件件，就算没有功劳也有苦劳吧？！”
“而今我只是想平安生下腹中孩儿，却成了痴念？”
“如此冷漠绝情，毫无慈悲之心，天理何在！”
老姬当场震怒道：“放肆！”
“我镇北候府，人杰地灵，英豪辈出，镇守青州北疆万里山河，斩妖除魔，鞠躬尽瘁，佑众生平安，靠的可不是慈悲，而是气吞天地的盖世神通！”
“你身染诅咒，生下的孩子根本无法继承灵根，一个不能修行的废物，将来上了战场，连当炮灰的资格都没有，必然葬身群魔之腹！”
“镇北侯府不需要一个毫无天资的后代，因为他自出生就注定是死路一条！”
大殿内的声音并不尖锐，却字字如刀，冷漠入骨。
叶无尘听到此处，只觉得好笑，他上一世证道登帝，独断万古，以一人之力平定黑暗动乱，也不敢说“鞠躬尽瘁，佑众生平安”这种大话。
这小小的镇北侯府，居然如此大放厥词！
奈何，他现在只是一个毫无修为的胚胎，一身神通根本无法施展。
content_en:
"Nine reincarnations, is this my ninth reincarnation?"
Ye Wuchen regained consciousness, but found that he could not open his eyes at all. His body was floating in the air, warm, and wrapped in a stream of liquid.
Descend to earth and reincarnate?
Still in mother's belly?
A great emperor became an unborn fetus...
Ye Wuchen's thoughts were a little confused, and then he began to explore the outside world.
In the courtyard of Hou Men's Mansion, I saw a young woman kneeling in the heavy snow, with blue lips, trembling, and an unusual but stubborn expression.
Her clothes were thin, her figure was delicate, and her belly was slightly bulging, as if she was pregnant.
"She is my mother in this life?"
Ye Wuchen couldn't help but feel a little angry. It was already December, the sky was filled with snow and ice was three feet deep, and a pregnant woman was actually punished to kneel in the snow.
There was a large hall directly in front. People in the palace were coming in and out. They all looked at the young woman with strange or disdainful eyes, pointed at her, and started talking in low voices.
"Ye Liuli, you have been married to my Jiang family for eight years and you haven't conceived a child yet. Now your husband is still away fighting. Suddenly, you have someone who doesn't know who you are pregnant with!"
"Shh, don't say this nonsense. The young lady is very kind to us on weekdays. She doesn't look like that kind of person."
"Knowing people, knowing faces, but not knowing their hearts. She pretends to be holy on weekdays, but who knows how easy-going Ye Liuli really is!"
"Hey, the young lady has become extremely weak since she sought medicine from the Holy Mountain. She has been kneeling in the snow for ten hours now, with a fetus in her belly. I am really afraid that she will not be able to hold on, and she will die."
Ye Liuli ignored the comments from outsiders and kept his unyielding gaze on the hall.
At this time, an old lady's voice came from the hall:
"Ye Liuli, I'm warning you one last time, you must abort the fetus in your belly within seven days!"
"You come from a humble background, are weak and sick, and the children you give birth to are trash without spiritual roots. They will only disgrace the lintel of my Zhenbei Hou Mansion. Do you understand?"
This person's condescension, harsh tone, and vicious attitude are simply suffocating.
Ye Liuli's eyes were red, and she choked with dissatisfaction and said: "For generations, my Ye family has followed the Marquis in south and north wars. We have lived and died for the Marquis with unparalleled loyalty. I have sacrificed many heroic men during this period. Is everything the Ye family has done only earned you the word "despicable" in your mouth?
"I am weak and sickly. That's because Wen Kang was seriously injured three years ago. I had to go to the Holy Mountain to seek medicine, and I suffered the backlash of the curse!"
"Wenkang is also your biological son, and the flesh and blood in my arms is also your biological grandson. Don't you have any emotion at all?"
There was silence for a moment in the hall.
Then Lao Ji responded with a stronger voice: "It is precisely because the Marquis will reward you for your merits that you, a daughter of the Ye family, can marry into the Marquis's house and enjoy this endless glory. It's okay if you don't know how to cherish it. You still have crazy thoughts. How stupid!"
"Moreover, because I thought about your request for medicine for Wenkang three years ago, I am particularly tolerant to you. Otherwise, I would have punished you for the serious crimes you committed, and the family law will take care of you!"
With tears in her eyes, Ye Liuli laughed at herself and said: "My Ye family is full of loyal people and has made numerous military exploits for the Zhenbei Hou Mansion. In order to cure my husband's injury, I went to the Holy Mountain to seek medicine and was infected with the evil curse. These things happened one after another. Even if there is no credit, there is hard work, right?!"
"Now I just want to give birth to my baby safely, but it has become an obsession?"
"So cold and heartless, without mercy, where is the justice of heaven!"
Lao Ji said angrily on the spot: "How outrageous!"
"I am the Marquis of Zhenbei. I have many outstanding people and heroes. I guard the mountains and rivers thousands of miles away in the northern border of Qingzhou, slay demons and demons, dedicate my whole life, and bless all living beings. What I rely on is not compassion, but my unparalleled magical power that swallows up the world!"
"You are cursed and the child you give birth to will not be able to inherit your spiritual roots at all. A waste that cannot practice cultivation will go to the battlefield in the future and will not even be qualified to be cannon fodder. It will inevitably be buried in the belly of the demons!"
"The Zhenbei Hou Mansion does not need an untalented offspring, because he is destined to die since he was born!"
The voice in the hall was not sharp, but every word was like a knife, cold to the bone.
When Ye Wuchen heard this, he just thought it was funny. In his previous life, he had achieved enlightenment and became emperor. He had been dictatorial for all eternity and single-handedly quelled the chaos of darkness. He did not dare to say such big words as "devoting his whole life to bringing peace to all living beings."
This small Zhenbei Hou Mansion is so arrogant!
However, he is now just an embryo with no cultivation, and he cannot use his magical powers at all.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 1 The Ninth Emperor reincarnated into a fetus Volume 1 Chapter 2 Ye Wuchen took action to change his fate against the will of heaven
